name: semantic-formatting-and-policy-intent-v1
asymmetric: Reuse the original rule-conditioned comment vectors; encode the four supplied support comments as plain documents with the identical pinned Qwen encoder. Keep 1024 dimensions and the original centroid scoring function.
intent: Compare the existing generic violation hypothesis with one deterministic affirmative behavioral hypothesis derived from rule text. Remove only the prohibitory wrapper; retain the policy's complete scope and its offer/request distinction. Do not choose paraphrases using scores.

policies: No legal advice: Do not offer or request legal advice.
No medical advice: Do not offer or request specific medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment recommendations.
error_audit.sampling: Four distinct normalized bodies per policy, true-label and reference-score tertile; select by SHA256(seed, normalized body). Forty-eight rows, no new-model score shown during annotation.
error_audit.purpose: Qualitative failure analysis, not a prevalence estimate or authoritative relabeling. Keep original labels and raw text private.

decision: Report every comparison, per-policy behavior, probability losses, conditional paired intervals, screening stability, support sensitivity and inference cost. Prefer the simpler existing centroid unless a new representation improves macro AUC without a material per-policy or probability-quality regression. No automatic promotion or reserve-target access.
